page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates exactly one thread per physical core, ensuring dedicated, non-shared CPU execution resources for workloads.

The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating systems and persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource allocation perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy tasks that do not require large memory footprints. The lack of hyperthreading provides predictable CPU performance, though the absence of local NVMe storage means storage-intensive operations rely entirely on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs.

This hardware profile is suited for compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and front-end servers where CPU performance is prioritized over memory capacity or local disk I/O.
